learning_outcomes.text: Understands refrigeration systems, main and auxiliary components.
Analyzes the vapor compression and absorption refrigeration systems.
Understands the parameters effecting refrigeration system performance.

syllabus_topics: Single and double system; thermodynamic analysis
Single and double system; thermodynamic analysis
Vapor Compression Refrigeration Cycle; applications and auxiliary components
Absorption refrigeration systems and cycle analysis
Cold storage and cooling load calculations
